preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 50,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= r2 <= n and r1 != r2
preconditions.description: The indices of the old capital r1 and the new capital r2 must be valid city indices and must be different.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The list p must contain n - 1 integers, each representing a valid city index.

postconditions.description: The output must contain n - 1 integers representing the new road map.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be a valid city index.
The output must match the new representation of the road map as a space-separated string.
